resources.string: Flexible eSIM Transfer
Route incoming eSIM transfers and new downloads to a real eUICC you choose. Routing starts OFF.

Enter the destination card’s exact EID from your existing LPA. Only its SHA-256 fingerprint is saved. Leave the port blank for a card with one active port; otherwise enter the port index explicitly. The card must already be active in Android.
Destination EID (exactly 32 digits)
Port index (blank: the only active port)
Route to this eUICC
Enable routing

This changes the destination of ALL new downloads in SIM Manager, including QR-code installs, not only transfers. Use this module on the receiving phone only. Close any existing transfer first. After saving, restart SIM Manager and Google Play services through your framework before starting a fresh transfer. Nothing is downloaded by this button. A real transfer can deactivate the source line.
Off / forget destination

Close any running transfer first. Existing routed processes will block further routed operations after a settings change until they restart. Restart both scoped apps through your framework to restore stock behavior. This does not undo a carrier transfer or remove a profile.

Scope SIM Manager and Google Play services, owner user. Reopen both processes after settings changes. Start a fresh incoming transfer in Android’s normal SIM settings only after activation. Carrier authorization still applies. Framework connection alone does not confirm hooks are loaded.
Enter exactly 32 ASCII digits, not all zero. Spaces are not removed.
Leave blank or enter a nonnegative integer. Spaces are not removed.
Framework unavailable. Enable the module and reopen this app.
Saving…
Save failed; framework state is unknown. Close any transfer and reconnect this settings app before retrying.
